scope: RC20 backend generation only; not a final-version run, frontend, Go build or application benchmark.

protocol.warm: fresh process immediately after the same variant's cold generation; exact input/output cache hit required

recovery.reason: Disk floor stopped the first js-date attempt after one successful warmup. The whole case restarted; this warmup is excluded from all medians.

unchanged47.scope: Unchanged inputs, with environment/protocol differences still disclosed

corrected4_context.scope: Historical context only: includes corrected Go FFI inputs

all51_context.scope: Historical context only: includes corrected Go FFI inputs

interpretation: Totals sum per-corpus medians of three retained measured samples. The 47 unchanged corpora support input-matched historical comparisons; the four corrected corpora and all-51 totals are context only. Environment and protocol differences remain; these data do not establish causality.
